# Distinct

Removes the repeated elements of an array, keeping the first of each.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Distinct(items)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | The array to read, which is left unchanged. Null is read as the empty array; any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Array. A new array holding each element of items that is not equal, by the `==` operator, to any element before it, in their original order. Never null.

## Example

`Distinct([1, 2, 1, 3, 2])` returns `[1, 2, 3]`.
